<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **19** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 57c51aab4d2f63293676e9412daed8a5fc54c1bc` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `758592682ba496fa71ed542a2a8e37a637d1c34e` — the merge of head `2eb99b8ab084ba5e002946acdae297eb03e92d72` into base `57c51aab4d2f63293676e9412daed8a5fc54c1bc`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 758592682ba496fa71ed542a2a8e37a637d1c34e && git checkout 758592682ba496fa71ed542a2a8e37a637d1c34e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 57c51aab4d2f63293676e9412daed8a5fc54c1bc 2eb99b8ab084ba5e002946acdae297eb03e92d72 && git checkout -B drift-repro 57c51aab4d2f63293676e9412daed8a5fc54c1bc && git merge --no-ff 2eb99b8ab084ba5e002946acdae297eb03e92d72

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 57c51aab4d2f63293676e9412daed8a5fc54c1bc
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 57c51aab4d2f63293676e9412daed8a5fc54c1bc` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读(席位终稿)

- **改了什么**:数据查询在 `where` 里拒收嵌套关联条件时,报错文字的顺序改成「位置 + 简短原因 + 该怎么写 + 未执行 + 补充原因」。拒收的情形有五种:第二层关联、带点的键、空对象、未声明的键、未注册的关联对象。另外,两类拒收的开头只列条件里的第一个键,其余的键只计数。
- **为什么改**:客户端只读报错的前 500 个字符。原先「该怎么写」排在「未执行」之后,字段名稍长一点就被截掉;第二层关联和带点的键在普通字段名下就已经看不到 `$in` 写法。长名字下,#27350 的无运算符对象拒收也还有 6 行被截。
- **风险与回滚**:只改报错文案的顺序和措辞。拒收范围、错误码 `INVALID_FILTER`、状态码 400、500 字符截断都不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`relation-filter-lowering.ts` 里 `relationConditionRefusalMessage` 的五个分支与 `describeKeys`;`no-operator-object-door.ts` 里的 `describeObject`;`relation-condition-prescription-cap.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/relation-condition-prescription-cap.test.ts src/no-operator-object-prescription-cap.test.ts`,预期 2 个文件 20/20 通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(非受管面,307 行)。
- **席位意见**:收下。和 #27098、#27173、#27337 同一类修法,这次把同类最后一个产出处也收了。

The source is +43/−28 across two producers: `relation-filter-lowering.ts`, which has `relationConditionRefusalMessage`, `describeKeys` and `idsRoute`, and `no-operator-object-door.ts`, which has `describeObject`. There are two cap pins, two in-surface wording pins and one `patch` changeset. `check-governed-merges --pr 27531`: 0 of 7 paths governed. No `packages/spec`, and no `skills/**`.

Every one of the five arms now puts the route before `The filter was NOT applied.` The `empty`, `dotted-key` and `second-level` arms were the ones that printed it last. The head drops the second naming of the field, and both heads name the first key plus a count. Code, status, cap and the refused set are untouched, since only the string assembly changed. The triage ruling holds: the route comes first, with margin. The stress residue from #27350 was measured here, not filed: before the change 6 rows ended at 501–532, and after it every row ends by 498. The card fixture's routes now end at 391 and 393, where they were 579 and 513.
- **Tests:** the ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` re-red both pins. The old order gives 15 of 15 failed, and three keys in `describeObject` gives 1 failed in the stress block. Both restores are byte-equal to HEAD. objectql at the head: 484 files / 9,104 tests passed.

Those two are `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which needs a whole-repo dist, and `check:type-check-debt --re-measure`, which got no lock turn. CI answers both families on this head (`Lint & Type Check`, debt ledger): green.

  - The targeted single-file runs ran outside the lock, as declared; the full suite ran under it.

I read the changeset against the diff and it matches. The new multi-valued ids-route spelling is shared with the cap refusal, and the changeset says so.
- **Out of scope + Skills-docs:** `Skills-docs: none` holds. The thin margin left on extreme stress rows (477–498) is recorded in the PR's Acceptance notes and not filed, since every row is inside the cut.
